mapper.sql: id, shield_id,shield_name,mete_type,meter_type,enable, create_user_id, end_time, shield_type, warn_content, create_time
mapper.select: select * from alarm_shield where warn_content like concat('%',#{warnContent},'%') and shield_type = #{shieldType} and enable = 1 order by end_time asc limit 1

select a.*, b.true_name as userName, c.device_mete_id, c.mete_name, c.custom_id, c.custom_name, c.device_id, d.device_name from alarm_shield a left join `sys_user` b on a.create_user_id = b.user_id left join t_std_devicemete c on FIND_IN_SET(c.device_mete_id,a.shield_id) left join t_std_device d on c.device_id = d.device_id where 1=1 and a.id in #{id}

select a.id from alarm_shield a where 1=1
and a.end_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and a.enable = #{enable} and a.shield_type = 2 and a.shield_type != 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `alarm_shield` ( `shield_id`, `shield_name`, `mete_type`, `meter_type`, `enable`, `create_user_id`, `end_time`, `shield_type`, `warn_content` ) VALUES ( #{shieldId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shieldName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{meteType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{meterType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{enable, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{shieldType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{warnContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR} );
mapper.select: select id from alarm_shield where meter_type = #{meterType} and enable = 1 and end_time >= #{time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and shield_type = 1 union all ( select id from alarm_shield where mete_type = #{meteType} and meter_type is null and enable = 1 and end_time >= #{time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and shield_type = 1 ) union all( select id from alarm_shield where FIND_IN_SET(#{shieldId},shield_id) and enable = 1 and end_time >= #{time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and shield_type = 1 )
